Definitions.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
create PROCEDURE  [dbo].[AA_GET_MAX_ID]
@TABLE_NAME NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @START_ID int,@END_ID int,@T_ID NVARCHAR(20)
SELECT @START_ID=START_ID,@END_ID=END_ID FROM SERVERS

select @T_ID = C.COLUMN_NAME FROM  
INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS T  
JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE C  
ON C.CONSTRAINT_NAME=T.CONSTRAINT_NAME  
WHERE  
C.TABLE_NAME= @TABLE_NAME 
and T.CONSTRAINT_TYPE='PRIMARY KEY'

-----------------------------------------------------------------
declare @result table ([rowcount] int);
insert into @result ([rowcount])
EXEC (' select (isnull(max( ' + @T_ID + ' ), ' + @START_ID + ' )+1) from    ' + @TABLE_NAME + '    WHERE   ' + @T_ID + '    BETWEEN ' + @START_ID + ' AND ' + @END_ID );
declare @rowid int = (select top (1) [rowcount] from @result);
-----------------------------------------------------------------

RETURN @rowid


end

CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[Network_Edit_Tracker_insert]
@User_ID	int,
@Notes	nvarchar(MAX),
@Bill_ID nvarchar(50),
@CP_Name	nvarchar(600),
@Operation_ID	int	,
@Screen_Type	int	
--@DATE NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @T_ID int
--SELECT @T_ID = (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(T_ID),0) FROM Network_Edit_Tracker)+1
EXEC @T_ID = AA_GET_MAX_ID 'Network_Edit_Tracker'


	insert into Network_Edit_Tracker (T_ID,Date,User_ID,Notes,Bill_ID,Operation_ID,Screen_Type,CP_Name)
	values(@T_ID,GETDATE(),@User_ID,@Notes,@Bill_ID,@Operation_ID,@Screen_Type,@CP_Name)

end

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[Network_Edit_Tracker_V]
AS
SELECT        dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.T_ID, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.CP_Name, dbo.Users.UserName, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Date, dbo.AgentBalance_Type.Type_Name, dbo.Operation_Types.Operation_Name, 
                         dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Notes, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Bill_ID, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Screen_Type, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Operation_ID, dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.User_ID
FROM            dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Users ON dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.User_ID = dbo.Users.User_ID INNER JOIN
                         dbo.AgentBalance_Type ON dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Screen_Type = dbo.AgentBalance_Type.id INNER JOIN
                         dbo.Operation_Types ON dbo.Network_Edit_Tracker.Operation_ID = dbo.Operation_Types.T_ID

Definitions.name: Network_Edit_Tracker_V_SELECT
Definitions.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Network_Edit_Tracker_V_SELECT]
@D_F	DATE,
@D_T	DATE,
@USER_ID INT
AS
BEGIN

IF @USER_ID = 0 
BEGIN
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Date) AS IDX
      ,[T_ID]
      ,[CP_Name]
      ,[UserName]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Type_Name]
      ,[Operation_Name]
      ,[Notes]
      ,[Bill_ID]
      ,[Screen_Type]
      ,[Operation_ID]
      ,[User_ID]
 from Network_Edit_Tracker_V WHERE CONVERT(DATE,Date) BETWEEN @D_F AND @D_T ORDER BY Date ASC
END
ELSE
BEGIN
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Date) AS IDX 
      ,[T_ID]
      ,[CP_Name]
      ,[UserName]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Type_Name]
      ,[Operation_Name]
      ,[Notes]
      ,[Bill_ID]
      ,[Screen_Type]
      ,[Operation_ID]
      ,[User_ID]
	   from Network_Edit_Tracker_V WHERE CONVERT(DATE,Date) BETWEEN @D_F AND @D_T AND USER_ID = @USER_ID ORDER BY Date ASC
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[REDUCE_NETWORK_TRACKER] 
AS
BEGIN 
IF (SELECT COUNT(T_ID) FROM Network_Edit_Tracker) > 50000
BEGIN
DELETE FROM Network_Edit_Tracker WHERE T_ID IN (SELECT TOP 25000 T_ID FROM Network_Edit_Tracker)
END

END
